mapping_decisions: The table and three fields are a candidate mapping to validate against an authorized instance dictionary; documentation does not prove their availability or ACL visibility.
Captured sys_id, name and owned_by remain source assertions. A user reference does not establish that person's acceptance or business accountability.
Missing owned_by maps to unknown. Display-name-only references are rejected; no name-based identity matching occurs.
Business-service association, criticality and confidentiality lifetime are deliberately unmapped. No custom enterprise fields or ordinal score meanings are assumed.
Synthetic environment is a fixture boundary, not a native ServiceNow environment assertion.
Reference Link parsing accepts only the synthetic next-link shape. Other native header variants require separate qualification; no links are fetched.
documentation_facts: sysparm_display_value=false requests database values; reference values identify native records rather than display names.
sysparm_exclude_reference_link=true suppresses reference links; sysparm_fields limits requested fields.
sysparm_limit is applied before ACL evaluation. A short result is not used to establish completeness.
Offset advances by the requested limit. Link headers provide pagination references; this candidate never dereferences them.
qualification_gates: approve read-only source route and least privilege
separately authorize any future mutation adapter
